PART I

ITEM 1. Business

We design and sell analog and embedded processing products. We sell our products through a direct sales force, distributors and our website, which is an important channel to market for smaller customers.

Our competitors include emerging companies, particularly in Asia, and we face significant global competition from dozens of large and small companies. We believe that market share depends on breadth of product line, technical support and price.

Some customers may develop their own in-house products or move to a second source, and alternative technology could displace parts of our portfolio.

ITEM 1A. Risk Factors

Our business could be affected by tariffs and export controls. The U.S. Department of Commerce has added companies to the Entity List, and tariffs on imports could raise costs for our customers.

We are subject to antitrust and competition laws. An investigation by the European Commission or the Department of Justice could result in fines.

ITEM 3. Legal Proceedings

We are involved in various inquiries and proceedings that arise in the ordinary course of our business. We believe that the amount of our liability will not have a material adverse effect.

ITEM 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis

Revenue was $17.7 billion. Free cash flow represented 16.6% of revenue.

Major customer. One of our end customers accounted for 12% of revenue in both 2025 and 2024, recognized primarily in our Analog segment.
